title: Sales Invoice — the accounting-committing selling document
description: A sales invoice is where the selling cycle commits the general ledger: it carries its own posting date (distinct from the transaction date, because the accounting period an invoice lands in is a decision, not a consequence of when the sale happened) and it is the document a GL posting is derived from. The state enum is parity-locked to workflows/sales-invoice.yaml.

posting_date.description: The accounting date, which selects the period and therefore the ledger the invoice lands in. Required and deliberately separate from transaction_date: a document posted late is normal, a document posted into the wrong period is a correction.

due_date.description: The payment due date the ageing report measures against.

against_delivery_note.description: The delivery note this invoice bills, when the invoice is raised against a fulfilment rather than directly.

outstanding_amount.description: The unpaid remainder. Absent on a draft invoice, where nothing has been posted yet.

harvest: the sales invoice field surface (posting_date, due_date, against delivery note, outstanding amount)
the separation of transaction date from posting date

x-erp-provenance.note: Field and lifecycle shapes from the upstream sales invoice doctype, re-expressed. No upstream file was read into this repository; no upstream code, schema or text is copied.
